notes.title: RalphGame Halls Demo update
notes.notes: Hi everyone! I've just released a new build of the demo which now includes a much more informative tutorial, as well as the most up-to-date version of ralph and his mechanics. The level plays the same, but it should be a much cleaner version compared to the previous demo. If you've beat it once, you've already beat it, but if you haven't gotten a chance to, this is the premiere way to test out RalphGame

notes.title: Still here!
notes.notes: Just realized this steam page hasn't seen an update in quite some time. Here's one! The game is still being developed and as of writing this, Chapter 4 is a few days away from being totally feature complete, with Chapter 5 being scripted now as well. Thank you for supporting and this game WILL come out :D

notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.notes: The newest demo for RalphGame is now available to play on the Steam page (for free, of course). It's not very long but it may be depending on your experience with the game through other demos so far.. You'll have to dive and dodge your way past armed enemies and escape the halls, which proves to be harder than it sounds. Give it a try and let me know if you come across any issues, please send me a crash log if it does happen to crash too :)
